senses.gloss:
इर्य a. Ved.
—1 Instigating (प्रेरक).
—2 Destroying the enemies.
—3 A lord, master.
—4 Active, powerful, an epithet of Pūṣan and of the Aśvins.

ईर्य + .{@-र्या@} Wandering about as a religious mendicant.
.━{@Comp.@}: ईर्यपथः

ईर्य + -पथः
—1 the observances of a religious mendicant to obtain knowledge.
—2 the four positions of the body, i. e. going, standing upright,
 sitting and lying down.
